open_points.subject: captured trial-case validation and file copying
open_points.text: “runs copies the spooled input files into the content-addressed area through store and passes their digests; functions writes the file-carriage StoredValues” and “functions.add_captured_trial_case ... checks ... the case's fit to it” conflict with “runs copies a spooled file ... only after every check ... the input fits and sizes functions.add_captured_trial_case would make”; no non-mutating functions capability for those checks is named
open_points.question: Which module owns the fit-and-size decision for a captured case, and how can it be completed before runs copies fixture bytes without duplicating that decision?
options: functions exposes a non-mutating capture-validation capability that runs calls before copying
runs owns and performs the capture fit-and-size checks, and functions trusts the validated result
functions owns the complete validated copy-and-record operation, using store after runs supplies capture eligibility and source-file facts
open_points.default_guess: Have functions expose a non-mutating capture-validation result; runs uses it before copying, then functions records the already validated case.
